name: Pixi Hydrating Milky Serum 30ml Lightweight Deep Hydration Serum with Jojoba Oil and Aloe Vera
description:
Quench and revitalize your skin with Pixi Hydrating Milky Serum, a lightweight yet nutrient-rich formula designed to deliver deep hydration without heaviness. Infused with jojoba oil, aloe vera, rose flower extract, and glycerin, it nourishes, calms, and restores natural radiance. Vitamins C and E work to heal and protect, while glycerin traps moisture for a plump, dewy finish. Suitable for all skin types, this serum leaves your skin soft, hydrated, and glowing.
Key Features:
Volume: 30ml / 1.01 fl oz
Jojoba oil provides lightweight hydration
Aloe vera soothes and calms sensitive skin
Rose flower extract helps reduce inflammation
Vitamins C & E heal, nourish, and protect
Glycerin locks in moisture for a plump finish
Paraben-free and cruelty-free
How to Use:
Use morning and evening or when needed
Cleanse and tone skin before application
Massage 2–3 drops onto clean, dry skin
Follow with moisturizer for best results
Ingredients:
Aloe Vera calms & soothes
Vitamins C & E heal & nourish
Jojoba Oil moisturizes with lightweight feel
Rose Flower Extract reduces inflammation
Glycerin traps moisture in the skin
Safety Information:
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs
Discontinue use if irritation develops
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight

1 × Pixi Hydrating Milky Serum 30ml
